tickerText: [TENNIS] Elena Rybakina rallies past Coco Gauff 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 to reach the US Open final against defending champion Aryna Sabalenka — men's semis today pit Ben Shelton vs Frances Tiafoe and Alexander Zverev vs Karen Khachanov • [SQUASH] QTerminals Qatar Classic opens Friday in Doha with world No. 1 Mostafa Asal chasing his first title and Nouran Gohar making her PSA comeback after maternity leave • [BADMINTON] Lee Chong Wei renews BAM's offer of structured support to Lee Zii Jia after another Vietnam Open early exit, while Goh Jin Wei's ranking slide continues with a second-round loss • [PICKLEBALL] Gabriel Tardio and Noe Khlif rally from 3-11 to beat Pengsu Yong and Syed Uzair Sufi at the KL Cup as pro quarterfinals hit The Hood on Friday • [TABLE TENNIS] Wang Chuqin, Lin Yun-Ju and Macao's Zhu Yuling advance to WTT Champions Macao quarterfinals — Wang Yidi falls to Adriana Díaz in a five-set thriller

newsItems.title: Rybakina Reaches US Open Final
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 Elena Rybakina rallied from a set down to beat Coco Gauff 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 and will face defending champion Aryna Sabalenka in Saturday's US Open women's final.

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Opens in Doha
newsItems.excerpt: The QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum begins September 12–18 at the Khalifa International Tennis and Squash Complex, headlined by Mostafa Asal seeking his first title and Nouran Gohar's PSA return.

newsItems.title: Tardio and Khlif Survive KL Scare
newsItems.excerpt: Top seeds Gabriel Tardio and Noe Khlif dropped the opener 3-11 but stormed back 11-5, 11-1 to advance at the PPA Asia 1000 Leapmotor Kuala Lumpur Cup as quarterfinals begin Friday.

newsItems.title: Macao Quarterfinals Set
newsItems.excerpt: Wang Chuqin, Lin Yun-Ju and Macao's Zhu Yuling reached the WTT Champions Macao quarterfinals while Wang Yidi was upset by Adriana Díaz in a five-set round-of-16 thriller.
